title: Quenching Portuguese Oreo Biscuits Fritters
description: Jammy, shaggy fritters made from Oreo biscuits and strawberry jam, deep-fried to a crispy finish, perfect for a hangover cure.
instructions: Crush 12 Oreo biscuits into fine crumbs using a rolling pin or food processor.
Mix crumbs with 4 tbsp strawberry jam, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, and 100 g flour until sticky.
Gradually stir in 120 ml milk to form a thick batter that holds together.
Heat 200 ml vegetable oil in a deep pan to 170°C.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into the hot oil, frying until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side.
Remove fritters with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Dust fritters with powdered sugar and a light sprinkle of cinnamon.
Serve warm, optionally with a side of fresh fruit or a splash of lime juice.
